title: MOIRAI L3: velocity-free array-level P/S phase picking on real downhole 3-C arrays (AMBER)
description: Code, EMA-best model weights and reproducible figure/table scripts accompanying the paper 'When does array moveout help borehole phase picking? A leave-one-site-out, confound-free benchmark of array versus per-trace deep learning' (Kurosawa, IVXA, Japan; submitted to Geophysical Journal International). A geometry-invariant 2-D U-Net is trained under a strict leave-one-site-out protocol on the AMBER benchmark and evaluated zero-shot on the held-out site, in array vs per-trace configurations that differ only in whether cross-station moveout is available, with a station-shuffle control.
notes: AMBER benchmark data (Verdon et al. 2026) are not redistributed here and must be obtained from their own archive. After posting the EarthArXiv preprint, add its DOI to related_identifiers as isSupplementTo.
